home.title: Platform console
home.description: Every workspace on the platform, in one place: who they are, how they pay and what they are charged.

sections.tenantsLine: Every organization on the platform: the plan it holds and what it owes.
sections.couponsLine: Discounts on what an organization is charged: issue them, and switch them on or off.
sections.securityLine: Your two-step sign-in: set up, replace, recovery codes.
sections.whatsappLine: The number platform alerts go out from: connecting it, its templates, which alerts it sends.
sections.toolsLine: Businesses' MCP servers waiting for our approval: approve or reject.
sections.aiFailuresLine: The AI's tool calls that failed across tenants, by tool and error.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Every organization on the platform: its plan, its billing state and how many people use it.
tenants.shown: Showing the newest {shown} of {total}. Search to find the others.
tenants.noMatch: No tenant's name or slug contains “{search}”.
tenants.unread: The tenants couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.

confirm.unconfirmed: The console couldn't confirm whether this went through. Reload the page and check before trying again.

refusal.held: Billing writes are off in this environment, because its billing is the live payment account. Nothing was sent.
refusal.forbidden: The platform refused: this needs a platform administrator.
refusal.no_request: No billing setup was ever requested for this tenant, so there is nothing to repair. Assign a plan instead.
refusal.not_pending_payment: This tenant is not awaiting payment, so there is nothing to send or repair.
refusal.already_complete: Billing setup is already complete. Resend the payment link instead.
refusal.provisioning_failed: Billing setup did not complete. Nothing was charged. The billing state below is the platform's answer now.
refusal.setup_incomplete: Billing setup never completed, so there is no payment link to resend. Repair the setup first.
refusal.rate_limited: Too many sends. Try again in a minute.
refusal.rate_limited_wait: Too many sends. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
refusal.link_not_available: This checkout can no longer be resumed. Assign the tenant a plan again.
refusal.email_failed: A new payment link was issued and the old one no longer works, but the email did not send. Try again in a few minutes.
refusal.no_admin: This tenant has no active administrator to send to.
refusal.already_has_plan: This tenant already holds a plan. The page now shows it.
refusal.invalid_plan: That plan can no longer be assigned. Choose another.
refusal.awaiting_payment: This tenant is on a paid plan and has not paid. The onboarding email would let them into setup without paying, so it was not sent. Resend the payment link instead.
refusal.already_onboarded: This tenant has already finished onboarding.
refusal.failed: The console couldn't confirm what happened. The page now shows the tenant as the platform has it.
refusal.invalid_code: A code is 2 to 32 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
refusal.percent_out_of_range: A percentage is a whole number from 1 to 100.
refusal.amount_required: Enter an amount greater than zero.
refusal.currency_required_for_fixed: A fixed-amount coupon needs a currency.
refusal.invalid_duration: A duration is a whole number of months.
refusal.coupon_inactive: This coupon is disabled. Enable it before giving it.
refusal.coupon_exhausted: This coupon has been given to as many organizations as it allows.
refusal.already_assigned: This organization already has this coupon. Revoke that one first.

detail.missing: There is no tenant with this address.
detail.unread: This tenant couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
detail.billingHeld: Billing writes are off in this environment: its billing is the live payment account. Repair, resend, plans and coupons are refused here, and say so.

billingPanel.title: Billing
billingPanel.setupUnread: Couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
billingPanel.attemptsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
billingPanel.attemptsLast: {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}, the last on {at}

resend.label: Resend payment link
resend.what: A new payment link for the same checkout goes to the tenant's first administrator.
resend.old: The link sent before stops working. Nothing is charged here.
resend.done: A new payment link was sent to {email}. The previous link no longer works.

repair.label: Repair billing setup
repair.what: This runs billing setup again for this tenant and, once it is done, emails the payment link.
repair.nothing: It does not charge the customer, activate the plan or grant credits.
repair.doneEmailed: Billing setup is complete. The customer was emailed a payment link.
repair.doneNotEmailed: Billing setup is complete, but the email did not send. Resend the payment link.
repair.impossible: This setup failed in a way that retrying can't fix. Assign the tenant a plan again.

missingPlan.title: This tenant has no plan to work on

why.MISSING: It has no plan, and can't use the product until it is given one.
why.EXPIRED: Its access has ended. It can't use the product until it is given a plan.
why.SETUP_INCOMPLETE: A plan was requested and its setup never finished. Repair it above, or choose a plan below.
why.CONFLICTING: It holds more than one active plan. Nothing was changed automatically: which one is right is a commercial decision.

missingPlan.blocked: Sign-in, account security and billing still work for it. The inbox, AI, channels and everything else do not.
missingPlan.plansUnread: The plans couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
missingPlan.plansNone: No plan can be assigned: none is active and public.

assign.label: Assign and request payment
assign.what: {plan} is assigned. The tenant moves to Pending payment and its administrator is emailed a payment link.
assign.nothing: Nothing is charged here, and no access is granted until payment is confirmed.
assign.poc: To give access without charging, set the tenant up as a POC instead.
assign.done: The plan was assigned. The tenant is pending payment and was emailed a payment link.
assign.doneNotEmailed: The plan was assigned and the tenant is pending payment, but the email did not send. Resend the payment link.

disable.label: Disable tenant
disable.what: Nobody in this tenant can sign in until it is enabled again. Nothing is deleted.

enable.label: Enable tenant
enable.what: The tenant's people can sign in again.

onboarding.label: Resend onboarding email
onboarding.what: The tenant's administrator is emailed a new setup link.
onboarding.done: The onboarding email was sent to {email}.

tenantCoupons.title: Coupons
tenantCoupons.what: A coupon discounts what this organization is charged. Its plan and contracted price don't change.
tenantCoupons.unread: This tenant's coupons couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
tenantCoupons.fullPrice: Paying full price: no coupon is discounting its charges.
tenantCoupons.liveOpen: Discounted by {codes} right now, with no end date.

revoke.label: Revoke
revoke.what: {code} stops discounting. The next charge is the full plan price.
revoke.done: {code} was revoked. The next charge is the full plan price.

tenantCoupons.assignableUnread: The coupons to give couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
tenantCoupons.assignableNone: There is no active coupon to give. Create one in Coupons.

give.label: Give the coupon
give.what: {code} discounts every charge from today for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
give.whatOpen: {code} discounts every charge from today until it is revoked.
give.unchanged: The plan and its contracted price don't change.
give.done: The coupon was given. It applies from the next charge.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.description: A coupon discounts what an organization is charged. It never changes its plan or its contracted price: when the window closes, the charge returns to the plan price on its own.
coupons.held: Billing writes are off in this environment: its billing is the live payment account. Creating, enabling and disabling coupons are refused here, and say so.
coupons.unread: The coupons couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
coupons.empty: No coupon has been issued yet.
coupons.window: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} by default
coupons.given: {count, plural, =0 {Given to no organization} one {Given to # organization} other {Given to # organizations}}

disable.label: Disable
disable.what: {code} stops discounting at once, for every organization it was given to, and can't be given again until it is enabled.
disable.done: {code} is disabled. It stopped discounting everywhere it was given.

enable.label: Enable
enable.what: {code} discounts again wherever its window is still open, and can be given again.

create.title: Create a coupon
create.wholeMonths: A whole number of months, 1 or more.
create.exampleOtherCurrency: A {currency} coupon only discounts charges made in {currency}.
create.exampleFor: On a plan of {price} a month: {example}, every month for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
create.exampleOpen: On a plan of {price} a month: {example}, every month until it is revoked.
create.done: The coupon was created. It discounts nothing until it is given to an organization.

create.title: Create a tenant
create.name: Organization name
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It never changes.
create.slugInvalid: 2 to 50 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
create.plansUnread: The plans couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.

quoteRefused.plan_gone: That plan is no longer available. Choose another.
quoteRefused.volume_invalid: That volume isn't valid for this plan.
quoteRefused.failed: The price couldn't be read. Change the selection to ask again.

quote.pendingPayment: Pending payment. The plan activates only once payment is confirmed.
quote.notChargeable: Payments in this plan's currency can't be taken yet. The tenant is created pending payment.

create.expiresPast: The expiry has to be in the future.
create.domainsUnread: The feature areas couldn't be read. Reload the page before creating a POC.
create.areasOff: Anything not selected is switched off for this organization.
create.pocFree: No charge and no renewal: no card is collected, and access stops when the credits run out or the expiry passes.
create.confirmPaid: {name} is created pending payment. {email} is emailed a setup link and a payment link.
create.confirmPaidNothing: Nothing is charged here. The plan activates only once the customer pays.
create.confirmPoc: {name} is created on a POC with {credits} credits, starting now. {email} is emailed a setup link. Nothing is ever charged.
create.donePaid: {name} was created and is pending payment. No subscription is active and no credits were granted yet.
create.donePoc: {name} was created on a POC. No charge and no renewal.
create.setupIncomplete: {name} was created, but its billing setup did not complete. No payment link was sent and nothing was charged. Repair it on the tenant's page; don't create it again.

refusal.held: Billing writes are off in this environment, because its billing is the live payment account. Nothing was created.
refusal.slug_taken: A tenant with this slug already exists. Choose another.
refusal.invalid: The platform refused a field. Check the name, slug and admin's email.
refusal.expiry_past: The expiry has to be in the future.
refusal.unknown_domain: A feature area is no longer offered. Reload the page.
refusal.invalid_billing: That plan or volume can no longer be chosen. Choose again.
refusal.forbidden: The platform refused: this needs a platform administrator.
refusal.failed: The console couldn't confirm whether the tenant was created. Search the list before trying again.

create.languageHint: Its emails and its setup are in this language.

status.label: Status

what.ACTIVE: The tenant is set to active now, without waiting for payment or onboarding.
what.PENDING_ONBOARDING: The tenant is set to onboarding. Its people see setup, not the product, until onboarding finishes.
what.PENDING_PAYMENT: The tenant is set to awaiting payment. Its people see the payment page, not the product.
what.SUSPENDED: The tenant is set to suspended. Nothing is deleted.

status.noPlan: This tenant has no active plan, so it still can't use the product until it gets one.

warnings.no_access_source: The status changed, but the tenant has no plan, so it still can't use the product. Give it a plan.
warnings.open_checkout: A payment is still open for this tenant. If the customer pays, the payment sets the status again.
warnings.billing_may_resuspend: This tenant is behind on payment. Billing may suspend it again.
warnings.renewal_will_unsuspend: The next renewal sets this tenant back to active.
warnings.no_idp_identity: The email changed here, but this person has no sign-in identity to update.
warnings.unknown: The platform added a note this screen can't read. Reload the page to see the tenant as it is now.

refusal.reason_invalid: Give a reason of up to {max} characters.
refusal.invalid: The platform refused the change. Reload the page and try again.
refusal.forbidden: The platform refused: this needs a platform administrator.
refusal.failed: The console couldn't confirm what happened. The page now shows the tenant as the platform has it.
refusal.member_not_found: This member is no longer in the tenant. The page now shows who is.
refusal.system_admin: A platform administrator is never edited or removed from a tenant.
refusal.same_email: That is already this member's email.
refusal.email_taken: Another member or login already uses that email.
refusal.identity_shared: This person also belongs to other organizations, so their login can't move from here. Add the new email as a user instead, then remove this member.
refusal.idp_failed: The sign-in service didn't accept the change. Nothing was changed.
refusal.idp_unknown: Could not confirm the change with the sign-in service, and nothing was changed. Try again.
refusal.last_admin: This is the tenant's only owner. Add another owner first.
refusal.already_member: This person is already a member of this tenant.
refusal.slug_mismatch: The slug typed doesn't match this organization.
refusal.system_tenant: The System organization can't be deleted.
refusal.own_tenant: You can't delete the organization you are signed in to.
refusal.paid_subscription: This organization has a paid plan that can still charge. Cancel or end the plan first.
refusal.open_checkout: This organization has a payment the customer could still complete. Wait for it to expire, or cancel it first.
refusal.shopify_billed: Shopify bills this organization. The merchant must uninstall the app in Shopify first.
refusal.in_dunning: This tenant is in dunning: a payment is being collected. Wait for it to settle first.
refusal.grandfathered: This tenant is on a grandfathered plan, which isn't edited by hand.
refusal.state_not_editable: The plan can't be edited in its current state.
refusal.end_date_required: This tenant has no current period to keep. Choose an end date.
refusal.end_date_in_past: The date has to be in the future: a past date would end access at once.
refusal.no_subscription: This tenant has no plan, so there is no end date to set. Change the plan instead.
refusal.plan_unavailable: That plan can't be chosen for this tenant. Choose another.
refusal.volume_invalid: That volume isn't offered for this plan.
refusal.unknown_domain: A feature area is no longer offered. Reload the page.
refusal.billing_unreachable: Billing didn't answer, and nothing was changed. Try again.

members.title: Owners and users
members.unread: The members couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
members.empty: This tenant has no members yet.

email.label: New email
email.what: {name} signs in with {email} from now on. Their password and open sessions stay as they are.

remove.label: Remove
remove.what: {name} is removed from this tenant and can no longer sign in to it. Their conversations stay, unassigned.

add.title: Add a user
add.name: Name
add.label: Add user
add.what: {email} is added as {role} and emailed a link to set up their account.
add.done: {email} was added and emailed a setup link.

delete.title: Delete the organization
delete.intro: The organization is deleted for good, right away. This can't be undone.
delete.systemTenant: The System organization can't be deleted.
delete.label: Delete the organization
delete.what: {name} and everything in it is deleted for good: its users, conversations, customers, channels, knowledge, files and settings. This can't be undone.
delete.provider: Nothing is charged or refunded, and nothing is disconnected on WhatsApp, Meta or Shopify. What is still connected there is listed after.
delete.leftovers: Still connected on the provider side:
delete.uploadsLeft: Some of its files couldn't be removed from storage. The organization itself is deleted.

plan.title: Plan and credits
plan.intro: Changes here never charge and never create a payment.
plan.refusedUpfront: Refused, and why: a tenant Shopify bills (Shopify owns its billing), a tenant in dunning (a payment is being collected), and an end date that has passed (it would end access at once).
plan.endsAtOptional: Access ends on (leave empty to keep the current period's end)
plan.endsPast: The date has to be in the future.
plan.areasUnread: The feature areas couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
plan.plansUnread: The plans couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.

what.change_plan: The tenant moves to {plan}, with no charge.
what.set_end_date: The tenant's access ends on {date}, with no charge.
what.switch_to_poc: The tenant becomes a POC: {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} given, until {date}, with no charge.
what.add_credits: {credits, plural, one {# credit is} other {# credits are}} added to the tenant's balance, with no charge.

plan.renewalOff: Automatic renewal is turned off: the tenant won't be charged or renewed automatically.
plan.renewalOffKeep: Automatic renewal is turned off: the tenant won't be charged or renewed automatically, and access ends when the current period ends.

done.switch_to_poc: The tenant is now a POC.
done.add_credits: The credits were added. Renewal stays as it is.

plan.doneRenewalOff: Renewal is off: not charged or renewed automatically.

banner.label: Support mode
banner.in: You are working in {tenant} as its admin. Everything you do here is recorded as GOTCHA Support.
banner.inUnnamed: You are working in a customer's workspace as its admin. Everything you do here is recorded as GOTCHA Support.
banner.exitFailed: Support mode could not be ended. Try again.

enter.title: Support mode
enter.what: Work inside this workspace as its admin. Billing, ownership, secrets, deleting and disconnecting are refused, and the session ends on its own.
enter.reasonHint: Recorded in the workspace's history and in System's.
enter.ended: Support mode ended. You are back in the console.
enter.active: You are already in support mode in {name}.
enter.activeUnnamed: You are already in support mode in another workspace.
enter.endedOther: That session has ended. You can enter this workspace now.

refusal.reason_invalid: Write a short reason for entering.
refusal.forbidden: Only a GOTCHA admin can enter support mode.
refusal.mfa_required: Turn on two-step verification for your login first.
refusal.system_tenant: Support mode is for a customer's workspace, not System or your own.
refusal.active: You are already in support mode in another workspace.
refusal.no_session: Support mode could not be started. Nothing was changed.
refusal.not_kept: Support mode started, but this browser could not keep it. Try again.
refusal.none: There is no support session to return to.
refusal.failed: Support mode could not be started. Try again.

security.title: Security
security.description: Your two-step sign-in: an authenticator app and recovery codes. Platform admins need both.
security.unread: We couldn't read your two-step sign-in settings, so they aren't shown. This doesn't mean it's off.
security.unavailable: The sign-in server didn't answer, so what's set up can't be known right now. This doesn't mean two-step sign-in is off.

status.on: Two-step sign-in is on: an authenticator app and recovery codes.
status.off: Two-step sign-in isn't complete: it needs both an authenticator app and recovery codes.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.none: No authenticator app is set up.
authenticator.some: {count, plural, =1 {One app is set up.} other {# apps are set up.}}
authenticator.replace: To replace an app, add the new one, then remove the old one.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.none: No recovery codes have been made.

remove.sentence: Remove this app? Its codes will no longer be accepted.
remove.lastSentence: This is the only app. Without an authenticator app, you'll be asked to set one up again before you can continue.
remove.gone: This app no longer exists. Refresh the page.

platformWhatsApp.title: GOTCHA's WhatsApp number
platformWhatsApp.description: Platform alerts (approvals, credit, a waiting customer) go out from this number, never from a workspace's own number.
platformWhatsApp.unread: The number's state couldn't be read, so it isn't shown. This doesn't mean nothing is connected.

status.CONNECTED: Connected. Alerts go out from this number.
status.PENDING_WEBHOOK: Connected, but this number's replies aren't reaching GOTCHA from Meta yet. Alerts go out; a tap on Approve may not arrive.
status.TOKEN_INVALID: Meta no longer accepts GOTCHA's access to this number. Connect it again to restore it.
status.DISCONNECTED: No number is connected. Platform alerts don't go out on WhatsApp.
status.UNKNOWN: This number's state has no name in this version. Check with Meta to read it again.

source.env: Alerts go out now from the number set in the server's configuration. Connecting a number here replaces it.
source.dbOverEnv: A number is also set in the server's configuration. The number here is the one used.

connect.needs: Use a new number that has never been on WhatsApp, not GOTCHA's sales number. In Meta's window, create a new WhatsApp Business account for it.
connect.done: Connected. Read the number's state above.

problem.cancelled: Meta's window closed before a number was chosen. Nothing was connected.
problem.noCode: Meta didn't send back what's needed to connect. Try again.
problem.exchangeFailed: The number couldn't be connected. Try again.
problem.unavailable: Meta's window couldn't open here. Check that nothing blocks facebook.com, then try again.
problem.notConfigured: Signing up through Meta isn't set up on this server.

recheck.done: Checked. The state above is what Meta reports now.

disconnect.done: Disconnected. Alerts no longer go out on WhatsApp.
disconnect.first: Alerts stop going out on WhatsApp at once.
disconnect.second: The number stays registered with Meta and its templates stay, so connecting it again needs no new code.

retire.first: Alerts stop, and the number is taken off WhatsApp's Cloud API: it can't send or receive until someone registers it again.
retire.second: Use this only to stop using the number for good, or to move it to the WhatsApp app.

refusal.choose_one_number: That Meta account has more than one number. Connect again and pick exactly one in Meta's window.
refusal.number_belongs_to_workspace: That number belongs to a workspace on GOTCHA, so it can't be the platform's number. Use a new one.
refusal.waba_belongs_to_workspace: That WhatsApp Business account belongs to a workspace. In Meta's window, create a separate one for GOTCHA's alerts.
refusal.template_body_invalid: The text must keep each of its placeholders exactly once, and can't start or end with one.
refusal.template_not_editable: Meta sets this template's text. It can only be sent for review.
refusal.meta_edit_limit: Meta limits how often an approved template can be edited. Try again later.
refusal.template_not_approved: This alert can go out only once its template is approved in both Hebrew and English.
refusal.no_platform_number: Connect a number first. Without one, no alert goes out on WhatsApp.
refusal.meta_error: Meta refused the request. Try again; if it repeats, check the number in Meta's Business Manager.
refusal.forbidden: Only platform admins can change this.
refusal.failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
refusal.unknown_template: This version names a template the platform doesn't have. Refresh the page.
refusal.code_exchange_failed: Meta's sign-in couldn't be completed. Connect again.
refusal.no_waba: Meta's window gave no WhatsApp Business account. Connect again and create one for GOTCHA's alerts.
refusal.no_phone_numbers: That WhatsApp Business account has no number. Connect again and add the new number in Meta's window.
refusal.platform_store_unavailable: The platform isn't ready for this number yet: its tables aren't on this server. Nothing was changed.

templates.title: Alert templates
templates.description: Meta must approve each template, in Hebrew and in English, before its alert can go out.
templates.unread: The templates couldn't be read, so they aren't shown.
templates.synced: Read. Each state below is Meta's.
templates.noNumber: Templates can be sent for review once a number is connected.
templates.missing: No row for this language yet. Read states from Meta to create it.
templates.saved: Saved as a draft. Nothing was sent to Meta.

submit.first: Meta reviews the text, usually within a day.
submit.second: Once sent, it can't be called back.

templates.approvedEdit: Meta reviews an approved template again after an edit, and limits how often one can be edited.

alerts.title: Which alerts go out on WhatsApp
alerts.description: These switches are the platform's. Each person's own alert settings still apply on top.
alerts.needsApproval: Needs its template approved in Hebrew and English.
alerts.stopped: On, but nothing goes out until a number is connected again.

rides.gotcha_approval_required: Goes with the switch for an approval waiting.
rides.gotcha_verification_code: Sent when someone adds their WhatsApp number for alerts.

event.gotcha_conversation_escalated: A conversation handed to a person

toolsQueue.title: MCP servers waiting for approval
toolsQueue.description: A business's MCP server reaches its AI employees only after we approve it. Approve, or reject with a reason the business will read.
toolsQueue.unread: We couldn't read the queue just now.
toolsQueue.approveSecond: We'll connect to it and read its tools. Each tool arrives off, for the business to turn on.
toolsQueue.rejectFirst: Reject {name}? The business sees your reason on its screen.

unread.title: Couldn't open the console
unread.body: We couldn't check your access just now, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

badge: {count, plural, one {One failure group over the threshold in the last hour} other {# failure groups over the threshold in the last hour}}

aiFailures.title: Failed AI actions
aiFailures.description: The AI's tool calls that failed, timed out or were refused, across tenants. Ours only, never a business's.
aiFailures.unread: We couldn't read the failures. Refresh the page.
aiFailures.none: {hours, plural, one {No action failed in the last hour.} other {No action failed in the last # hours.}}
aiFailures.total: {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} {hours, plural, one {in the last hour} other {in the last # hours}}

recent.title: {count, plural, one {The latest failure} other {The latest # failures}}
recent.label: The latest failures
